datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments across Cameroon using the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) methodology to classify acute food insecurity phases in different scenarios. The resulting geographic classifications were compiled into monthly spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) for 2020, representing projected food insecurity conditions at the sub-national level.
